{"app": "shell", "action": "command", "command": "cat > /tmp/create_agenda.py << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# Create image
img = Image.new('RGB', (800, 400), color='white')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Title
try:
    font_title = ImageFont.truetype('DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 32)
    font_text = ImageFont.truetype('DejaVuSans.ttf', 24)
except:
    font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
    font_text = ImageFont.load_default()

draw.text((50, 30), 'Meeting Agenda', fill='black', font=font_title)

# Table header
draw.text((50, 100), 'Time', fill='black', font=font_text)
draw.text((250, 100), 'Topic', fill='black', font=font_text)

# Rows
rows = [
    ('13:00-13:30', 'Introductions by Linda'),
    ('13:30-14:10', 'Agenda by Davide'),
    ('14:10-14:30', 'Strategy by Charlie'),
]

y = 150
for time, topic in rows:
    draw.text((50, y), time, fill='black', font=font_text)
    draw.text((250, y), topic, fill='black', font=font_text)
    y += 50

img.save('tasks/3-50/testbed/data/agenda.jpg')
print('Image created')
EOF
python3 /tmp/create_agenda.py"}
